gen.guojia.bark.badbeat: Heaven's mandate... does not fall within my ten years.
gen.xunyu.name: Xun Yu
gen.xunyu.bio: A king-maker's talent — held in trust for Han.
gen.xunyu.tell.strong: Sits formal as rite; counsel laid out in clean order.
gen.xunyu.tell.weak: Thumb tracing the lid of an empty provision box.
gen.xunyu.bark.taunt: What Yu serves is the house of Han.
gen.xunyu.bark.smug: A steady hand at the center; ten quiet years.
gen.xunyu.bark.badbeat: In the end, no Han stipend left to eat...
gen.jiaxu.name: Jia Xu
gen.jiaxu.bio: One sentence threw the realm into chaos; a second carried him out whole.
gen.jiaxu.tell.strong: Eyes lowered as if dozing; speaks least at the table.
gen.jiaxu.tell.weak: Rolls the words around his mouth one more time.
gen.jiaxu.bark.smug: Keeping oneself whole is also a strategy.
gen.jiaxu.bark.badbeat: This move was never mine to make.
gen.tianfeng.name: Tian Feng
gen.tianfeng.bio: The blunt counselor, waiting out the victory from prison.
gen.tianfeng.tell.strong: Bows to the ground, speaks without trimming.
gen.tianfeng.tell.weak: Still working the calculations to the clink of chains.
gen.tianfeng.bark.taunt: Win, and Feng dies. Lose, and Feng dies.
gen.tianfeng.bark.tilt: Do not fight — fight, and we lose!
gen.tianfeng.bark.smug: I called it. What of it.
gen.tianfeng.bark.badbeat: My lord... would not listen after all.
gen.jushou.name: Ju Shou
gen.jushou.bio: His slow-war counsel fell on deaf ears.
gen.jushou.tell.strong: Stands clutching his plan, eyes like torches.
gen.jushou.tell.weak: Sighs at the great host fording the river.
gen.jushou.bark.taunt: Haste wins the day and loses the month.
gen.jushou.bark.tilt: Guard the grain! Guard the grain!
gen.jushou.bark.smug: This ground could have been taken slow.
gen.xuyou.name: Xu You
gen.xuyou.bio: One traitor's name, one torch at Wuchao.
gen.xuyou.tell.strong: Slaps an old friend's calling card, laughing loud.
gen.xuyou.tell.weak: Fingers an emptied cup, scanning the room for someone to fill it.
gen.xuyou.bark.taunt: A-Man — you still know my face?
gen.xuyou.bark.badbeat: You... dare show me such disrespect!
gen.liubiao.name: Liu Biao
gen.liubiao.bio: A fine host for parlor talk; a keeper, not a taker.
gen.liubiao.tell.strong: Plays his zither unhurried, every courtesy to guests intact.
gen.liubiao.tell.weak: Asks his lady, then asks her brother.
gen.liubiao.bark.taunt: Jingzhou needs only to keep itself.
gen.liubiao.bark.smug: One of the Eight Fine Gentlemen — the name is earned.
gen.liubiao.bark.badbeat: And after me... whom do I trust?
gen.sunhao.name: Sun Hao
gen.sunhao.bio: Wu's last and cruelest emperor; styled, at the end, Marquis of Guiming.
gen.sunhao.tell.strong: Hurls the cup and rises, fire in his eyes.
gen.sunhao.tell.weak: Counting how many loyal ministers survive.
gen.sunhao.bark.taunt: A green canopy for my throne and the North Star for my court!
gen.sunhao.bark.badbeat: Guiming... 'surrendered to destiny' — what a title!
gen.cenhun.name: Cen Hun
gen.cenhun.bio: The flatterer who chained the river shut.
gen.cenhun.tell.strong: Presents prophecies and portents with an air of total certainty.
gen.cenhun.tell.weak: Still crying injustice as the guards drag him off.
gen.cenhun.bark.open: Cen Hun, with a plan for lasting peace.
gen.cenhun.bark.taunt: Iron chains across the river — nothing slips past!
gen.cenhun.bark.badbeat: Why... why do you all stare at me!
gen.duyu.name: Du Yu
gen.duyu.bio: The Zuo Commentary devotee who never reined in.
gen.duyu.tell.weak: Counts off the ten-day weeks, pressing for river reports.
gen.duyu.bark.taunt: Like splitting bamboo — past a few joints, the blade runs free.
gen.duyu.bark.smug: Under ten thousand men — more than enough for these walls.
gen.duyu.bark.badbeat: Wait on the water, or on the hour?
gen.mengyou.name: Meng You
gen.mengyou.bio: Meng Huo's brother, advancing and retreating at his side.
gen.mengyou.tell.weak: Takes the field still holding his wine bowl.
gen.mengyou.bark.open: Meng You — holding the stockade for my brother!
gen.mengyou.bark.taunt: My brother is king of the southern lands!
gen.zhurong.name: Zhurong
gen.zhurong.bio: Descendant of the fire god; her flying blades collect what is owed.
gen.zhurong.tell.strong: Throwing knives across her back, smiling at ease.
gen.zhurong.tell.weak: Keeps one eye on the children's tent.
gen.zhurong.bark.taunt: The women of the south burn hotter!
gen.zhurong.bark.smug: If not the Lady, then who?
gen.wutugu.name: Wutugu
gen.wutugu.bio: King of Wuge, lord of rattan armor.
gen.wutugu.tell.strong: Rattan armor clattering on a twelve-foot frame.
gen.wutugu.tell.weak: Wrinkles his nose at the smell of tung oil.
gen.wutugu.bark.taunt: Blade and arrow bounce off. What have you left?
gen.wutugu.bark.smug: Rattan armor — nothing like it under heaven.
gen.wutugu.bark.badbeat: Fire... where does the fire come from!!
gen.dailai.name: Dailai, Lord of the Bana Caves
gen.dailai.bio: The cave lord who fetched the rattan armor.
gen.dailai.tell.strong: Eyes quick and rolling as he offers up the plan.
gen.dailai.tell.weak: Arranges for the credit to land on himself.
gen.dailai.bark.open: Dailai the cave lord — I have a plan!
gen.dailai.bark.taunt: The men I recommend never fail!
gen.chengyuanzhi.name: Cheng Yuanzhi
gen.chengyuanzhi.bio: A Yellow Scarf chieftain — where the great enterprise begins.
gen.chengyuanzhi.tell.strong: Waves his saber and roars; the numbers are on his side.
gen.chengyuanzhi.tell.weak: Looks back to check his lieutenant is still there.
gen.chengyuanzhi.bark.taunt: The Yellow Sky rules — all who stand in its way die!
gen.chengyuanzhi.bark.smug: The Way of Great Peace — a million strong.
gen.hucheer.name: Hu Che'er
gen.hucheer.bio: The halberd-thief who could carry five hundred jin.
gen.hucheer.tell.strong: The toasting hand is steady — too steady.
gen.hucheer.tell.weak: His gaze keeps sliding back to the weapon rack.
gen.hucheer.bark.open: Hu Che'er — a bowl to the General.
gen.hucheer.bark.taunt: I do the lifting. I don't take the stage.
gen.hucheer.bark.smug: Five hundred jin, and still at a trot.
gen.hucheer.bark.badbeat: The halberd... still in his hand!
gen.caizhong.name: Cai Zhong
gen.caizhong.bio: One of the twin false defectors.
gen.caizhong.tell.strong: His story matches his brother's to the drop.
gen.caizhong.tell.weak: The twins' signals land half a beat apart.
gen.caizhong.bark.open: Cai Zhong, surrendered soldier, at your orders.
gen.caizhong.bark.taunt: Lord Cao has treated us brothers well!
gen.caizhong.bark.smug: Whoever doubts a defector has something to hide.
gen.caizhong.bark.badbeat: Little brother... gone ahead of me.
gen.yuanshu.name: Yuan Shu
gen.yuanshu.bio: Dry bones in a barrow, clutching a jade seal and styling himself sovereign.
gen.yuanshu.tell.strong: Cradles the Imperial Seal, knuckles gone white.
gen.yuanshu.tell.weak: Counts the grain carts — then counts them again.
gen.yuanshu.bark.taunt: Four generations of my house have sat among the Three Excellencies!
gen.yuanshu.bark.tilt: I, the Emperor, will not suffer this!
gen.yuanshu.bark.smug: The mandate belongs to my Yuan clan.
gen.yuanshu.bark.badbeat: Honey water... is there no honey water?
gen.caopi.name: Cao Pi
gen.caopi.bio: Emperor Wen of Wei, crowned on the Abdication Terrace.
gen.caopi.tell.strong: Abdication edict in hand; every character weighs a thousand.
gen.caopi.tell.weak: Looks back toward Ye and its old pear trees.
gen.caopi.bark.taunt: Abdication merely lends the realm a stair to descend with dignity.
gen.caopi.bark.tilt: The ways of Shun and Yu — I know them now!
gen.caopi.bark.smug: Wei for Han — the way of the mandate.
gen.caopi.bark.badbeat: Seven paces... a poem is nothing!
gen.liuzhang.name: Liu Zhang
gen.liuzhang.bio: A keeper of what he was given — until the day he opened the gates.
gen.liuzhang.tell.strong: Weeps over the city registers; his courtesy never slips.
gen.liuzhang.tell.weak: Looks out at the elders of the city and cannot speak.
gen.liuzhang.bark.taunt: Zhang was never made for an age of chaos.
gen.liuzhang.bark.smug: Peace kept in Shu — that too is a merit.
gen.liuzhang.bark.badbeat: Father to son, and still we could not hold it.
story.taoyuan.objective: Shield the village volunteers from the Yellow Scarves — and let three strangers' oath survive its first defeat.
story.taoyuan.coldOpen.0.text: In Zhuo Commandery, peach blossoms drift onto the posted notice; rain bleeds the characters 'Yellow Scarf' into each other. Three hands reach to tear it down at once, fingertips meeting.
story.taoyuan.coldOpen.1.text: Bei has nothing but straw sandals and hot blood. If you two would walk this road, lend your lives to the villagers first.
story.taoyuan.coldOpen.2.text: I've got wine, I've got a spear, and I've never feared staking my life! But if we lose — who buries us?
story.taoyuan.coldOpen.3.text: So today we do not pledge to win together. We pledge one thing only: whoever falls back, the other two bring him home.
story.taoyuan.map.0.title: Peach Grove · Terms of Retreat First
story.taoyuan.map.0.lines.0.text: We swear brotherhood and don't drink first? I'm not even afraid of which hill they'll bury me on!
story.taoyuan.map.0.lines.1.text: Not fearing death is the easy part. The hard part is watching a brother lose, and setting down your own hard-won name to go fetch him.
story.taoyuan.map.0.lines.2.text: Then this clause comes before 'same year, same month.' Only those who come back march together again.
story.taoyuan.map.0.choices.0.text: Write 'we bring each other back' into the oath
story.taoyuan.map.0.choices.0.detail: Enemy starts with -1 morale; remember the pact of rescue
story.taoyuan.map.0.choices.1.text: First teach the volunteers to read the way out
story.taoyuan.map.0.choices.1.detail: Reads improved this round; remember the volunteers' retreat
story.taoyuan.battle.0.text: I charge first! Don't lag behind and give the Scarves a laugh!
story.taoyuan.battle.1.text: Yide presses the line while Xuande shields the volunteers. Don't let all three push forward and hand the enemy your backs.
story.taoyuan.battle.2.text: Yide, come back! You swore someone would catch the fallen — the oath is not only for others to keep.
story.taoyuan.battle.3.text: Don't stare at the fallen banner. First see who still waits with a hand out.
story.taoyuan.win.text: Peach petals settle in three bowls. Liu Bei pushes a fourth toward you — without asking you to call him brother. 'Today you saw how we began. If someday one of us is lost, remember for us the way back.'
story.taoyuan.win.hook: The Peach Garden wine has not worn off, and the lords are already swearing pacts at Suanzao. The next cup must be kept warm in front of a man named Hua Xiong.
story.taoyuan.loss.text: The wine is still warm, but the three of you are pinned in three separate places. You finally understand: if 'living and dying together' only means charging at the same time, it is just three lonely battles that never see each other.
story.taoyuan.loss.clue: Lesson · Rescue is not all three shoving all-in together: one presses the line, one holds the way back. Restart with +150 war chest; leave your partner a retreat first.
story.sishui.objective: Amid the lords' contempt and Hua Xiong's streak, win Guan Yu a cup still warm and a chance to ride out.
story.sishui.coldOpen.0.text: Nineteen cups sit poured in the lords' tent while Hua Xiong takes his second head outside the pass. The third cup is filled. No one rises.
story.sishui.coldOpen.1.text: This cup I pour myself. Whoever brings me Hua Xiong's head will find it still warm on his return.
story.sishui.coldOpen.2.text: Our Peach Garden oath was never a call for brothers to die in my place. Keep the cup — Guan will come back to drink it himself.
story.sishui.coldOpen.3.text: Second Brother, I'll beat the drum for you. And if you don't come back, I'll never drink again, no matter how warm they pour it!
story.sishui.intros.huaxiong.0.bio: He remembers the cup that never cooled last time — and remembers better who was in no hurry.
story.sishui.intros.huaxiong.0.quote: Pouring again? This time I'll cool it before the feast begins.
story.sishui.intros.huaxiong.1.bio: The streak has convinced him every challenger will be in more of a hurry than the last.
story.sishui.intros.huaxiong.1.quote: The wine is at the perfect warmth. So is your head.
story.sishui.map.0.title: Sishui · A Cup for a Token
story.sishui.map.0.lines.0.text: The whole tent is counting Hua Xiong's kills. Yunchang alone is watching where he turns to look after each one.
story.sishui.map.0.lines.1.text: He counts on the next streak to break the lords' nerve. If I refuse to do his hurrying for him, the hurry becomes his.
story.sishui.map.0.choices.0.text: Leave the wine in the tent; make no bold vow
story.sishui.map.0.choices.0.detail: Hua Xiong starts with -1 morale; remember the promise of that cup
story.sishui.map.0.choices.1.text: First watch how Hua Xiong reins his horse around
story.sishui.map.0.choices.1.detail: Reads improved this round; remember where he looks back
story.sishui.battle.0.text: Another one chasing fame with a cup of wine. You'll lose three times before it cools.
story.sishui.battle.1.text: The wine's surface is still calm. Yunchang — what the tent hurries is the drum, not your blade.
story.sishui.battle.2.text: Guan is in no hurry. If he only swings while riding a streak, then before this cup cools, the one in a hurry will be him.
story.sishui.win.text: Guan Yu returns the cup to Cao Cao's hand, the wine still warm at the surface. Liu Bei unclasps his dust-caked cloak; Zhang Fei's drum falls silent only now. Cao Cao looks at you instead: 'The whole tent was in a hurry just now. Only you were willing to wait for him.'
story.sishui.win.hook: Hua Xiong is driven back, and the gates of Hulao swing open. Lü Bu has one question: the one who kept the wine warm — dare he come again?
story.sishui.loss.text: The wine has gone stone cold, and no one in the tent speaks of a second cup. You did not lose to Hua Xiong's quick blade — you misheard 'come back and drink' as 'win this instant.'
story.sishui.loss.clue: Lesson · The warm wine was never a demand for a fast win; it was faith that you would come back. Hua Xiong's streaks goad you into swinging first. Make him do the hurrying — on restart he begins with -1 morale.
story.hulao.objective: Read Lü Bu's advances and retreats, and win your first 'impossible' before Hulao Pass.
story.hulao.coldOpen.0.text: One lazy point of the painted halberd up on the pass, and the lords' banners seem to shrink a head shorter. You have only just arrived when Liu Bei slides a cup of wine in front of you.
story.hulao.coldOpen.1.text: My second brother's cup took Hua Xiong's head. This cup today — do you dare take it?
story.hulao.coldOpen.2.text: Everyone knows how this page ends. No one knows why you are in it.
story.hulao.coldOpen.3.text: You again. What we left unfinished last time — settle it all today.
story.hulao.intros.lvbu.0.bio: He remembers you across the table last time, and how you took down the pot.
story.hulao.intros.lvbu.0.quote: Don't wave the lords at me. You — come up alone.
story.hulao.intros.lvbu.1.bio: Before Hulao Pass, 'peerless under heaven' is the shortest challenge he knows how to write.
story.hulao.intros.lvbu.1.quote: All three heroes at once, or you alone. Don't keep me waiting.
story.hulao.map.0.title: Sishui · The Three Heroes' Old Pact
story.hulao.map.0.lines.0.text: His strength was never playing every hand — it is that once you flinch, he no longer needs cards at all.
story.hulao.map.0.lines.1.text: Why all this talk! Let me go tip him over a round for you first!
story.hulao.map.0.choices.0.text: Ask the Three Heroes to stand at your flank
story.hulao.map.0.choices.0.detail: +100 war chest; Lü Bu starts with -1 morale
story.hulao.map.0.choices.1.text: Watch him play out one hand alone
story.hulao.battle.0.text: Your chips are like the lords' courage — they look plentiful enough.
story.hulao.battle.1.text: The better his run, the more he writes his strong hands on his brow. Don't do his frightening for him.
story.hulao.battle.2.text: Good! Now it deserves the name Hulao!
story.hulao.battle.3.text: So 'never retreat' was never courage — just the only way he knows how to win.
story.hulao.win.text: The painted halberd hits the ground, and the lords make no cheer. Liu Bei steadies you first; Guan Yu picks up the cup that was never touched.
story.hulao.win.hook: Before he fled, Lü Bu learned your name. The next meeting will not be at Hulao.
story.hulao.loss.text: You retreated with the lords. Only after leaving Hulao do you understand: all along he was forcing you to treat 'finest under heaven' as a fifth community card.
story.hulao.loss.clue: Lesson · Lü Bu magnifies fear with relentless pressure; on restart, his false tells come fewer.
story.fengyiting.objective: Set Dong Zhuo and Lü Bu doubting each other across one table, and play the last step of the interlocking stratagem for Diao Chan.
story.fengyiting.coldOpen.0.text: The lotus at Phoenix Pavilion bloom in perfect stillness. Dong Zhuo waits outside for his beauty; Lü Bu waits behind the rockery for an explanation. Diao Chan waits only for them to share a table.
story.fengyiting.coldOpen.1.text: The Grand Chancellor wants my submission; the General wants my vow. Today I answer neither — I want them to hear each other's answer.
story.fengyiting.coldOpen.2.text: At Hulao you forced me back a step. Make me yield again today, and it will not be I who leaves — it will be this whole Mei stronghold.
story.fengyiting.coldOpen.3.text: Fengxian, I have been generous with you. Must even you peek at her through the bead curtain?
story.fengyiting.intros.dongzhuo.0.bio: The locks at Mei have been changed, yet he still believes every loyal heart can be locked away in his vault.
story.fengyiting.intros.dongzhuo.0.quote: Come to sow discord again? This time I watch you first, and Fengxian second.
story.fengyiting.intros.dongzhuo.1.bio: He keeps his favors in a ledger, and expects Lü Bu to repay them, entry by entry, in obedience.
story.fengyiting.intros.dongzhuo.1.quote: Father and son at one table — what is there that cannot be said aloud?
story.fengyiting.intros.lvbu.0.bio: After Hulao he learned to back down once, but never again would he let anyone else decide where he belongs.
story.fengyiting.intros.lvbu.0.quote: Last time you won my halberd. This time — don't choose for her.
story.fengyiting.intros.lvbu.1.bio: The old defeat dulled nothing; it only made him less able to bear being treated as another man's property.
story.fengyiting.intros.lvbu.1.quote: I know you. And I know that look in your eye — the one that says 'for your own good.'
story.fengyiting.intros.lvbu.2.bio: His Sky Piercer stands outside the pavilion, yet what he fears most is one ambiguous sentence inside it.
story.fengyiting.intros.lvbu.2.quote: Let her say it plainly. You too.
story.fengyiting.map.0.title: Fengyi Pavilion · One Sentence, Two Ears
story.fengyiting.map.0.lines.0.text: If they come to question me separately, I can only answer in halves. Seat them together, and the Grand Preceptor raises only after glancing at Fengxian, while Fengxian folds to the sound of the Preceptor's laughter.
story.fengyiting.map.0.lines.1.text: So you need not deceive two men. You need only make one true sentence land differently in two pairs of ears.
story.fengyiting.map.0.lines.2.text: No. I want them to finally understand that I am not the prize inside that sentence.
story.fengyiting.map.0.choices.0.text: Let Dong Zhuo see Lü Bu hesitate first
story.fengyiting.map.0.choices.0.detail: Reading improves this chapter; note the Preceptor's suspicion
story.fengyiting.map.0.choices.1.text: Let Lü Bu hear Dong Zhuo's possessiveness
story.fengyiting.map.0.choices.1.detail: Enemy opens with -1 morale; note Fengxian's rage
story.fengyiting.battle.0.text: No hole cards today — only the name of father and son. Whoever first treats the other as an enemy opens the hand for me.
story.fengyiting.battle.1.text: Fengxian — will you leave with her, or with me? Think it through before you bet.
story.fengyiting.battle.2.text: All that talk of how generously you treated me, Father. So you kept count of everything I owed.
story.fengyiting.battle.3.text: Don't look at me. Look at yourselves: one terrified of losing power, one terrified he was never his own man.
story.fengyiting.win.text: Diaochan pushes open the pavilion door and, for the first time, speaks without borrowing anyone's expression. Dong Zhuo and Lü Bu go on staring at each other until 'father and son' is nothing but a torn invitation. She runs to neither man; she simply walks her own road out of Mei.
story.fengyiting.win.hook: After Fengyi Pavilion, Lü Bu and Diaochan both leave Mei. But an envoy from Xiaopei is already on the road — next chapter, he comes to make peace between two houses.
story.fengyiting.loss.text: Dong Zhuo takes it for a rivalry over a woman; Lü Bu, for deception. Diaochan removes her earrings and does not weep: you tried to win two men for her, and forgot that what she wanted to win was one sentence — that she belonged to no one.
story.fengyiting.loss.clue: Lesson · Don't probe Dong Zhuo and Lü Bu separately. When one bets, watch where the other looks first. The crack in the chain trick runs between the two of them; on retry, false tells are reduced.
story.yuanshemen.objective: Keep a line of retreat open for both Ji Ling and Liu Bei — and force Lü Bu to prove that arrow is not just another brand of arrogance.
story.yuanshemen.coldOpen.0.text: Outside the camp gate, a halberd's small branch waits to be hit; inside it sit two armies one word away from slaughter. Lü Bu sets his bow on the table and asks you to deal first.
story.yuanshemen.coldOpen.1.text: At Hulao you said I only knew how to press forward. Today both houses are watching — watch me make them withdraw with a single arrow.
story.yuanshemen.coldOpen.2.text: Ji Ling, hear my order: take Xiaopei, or never show your face in Huainan again! My imperial seal deserves the empire, not a favor to Lü Bu.
story.yuanshemen.coldOpen.3.text: I ride under my lord's orders; one arrow will not turn me back. Unless every man at this table agrees the arrow is worth the wager.
story.yuanshemen.coldOpen.4.text: Bei will not spend the lives of Xiaopei's people to prove anyone's marksmanship.
story.yuanshemen.intros.jiling.0.bio: He still refuses to accept that arrow, but he has begun, seriously, to weigh the other life hanging on it.
story.yuanshemen.intros.jiling.0.quote: We can wager again. First, state both houses' terms — word for word, no changes.
story.yuanshemen.intros.jiling.1.bio: His trident rides on a military order; he cannot retreat looking like a man frightened off by a trick shot.
story.yuanshemen.intros.jiling.1.quote: General Lü has his godly archery. I have my orders.
story.yuanshemen.map.0.title: The Camp Gate · One Shared Stake
story.yuanshemen.map.0.lines.0.text: One arrow and my brother's off the hook? If he misses, I'll snap that bow over his head first!
story.yuanshemen.map.0.lines.1.text: So the hard part isn't the hit. It's making both houses honor the ledger even if he misses.
story.yuanshemen.map.0.lines.2.text: Then spell out what happens on a miss as well. I don't lean on another man's confidence today.
story.yuanshemen.map.0.choices.0.text: State first what happens if the arrow misses
story.yuanshemen.map.0.choices.0.detail: Reading improves this chapter; remember the shared stake
story.yuanshemen.map.0.choices.1.text: Seat Xuande and Ji Ling on the same side
story.yuanshemen.map.0.choices.1.detail: Ji Ling opens with -1 morale; remember the courtesy of the shared table
story.yuanshemen.battle.0.text: Never mind the trick shot. If I win this hand — do you dare let Xuande fight his way out of the city too?
story.yuanshemen.battle.1.text: If I miss, I'll honor your terms. But if all you want is to see me embarrassed, you've misread this hand.
story.yuanshemen.battle.2.text: General Ji — what you must win today is not your orders, but the ability to face your soldiers again once you return.
story.yuanshemen.win.text: As the arrow flies, Ji Ling watches Liu Bei, not the branch. Only when Liu Bei slides his blade a discreet inch away does Ji Ling finally stand down. Lü Bu laughs — only you see the sweat on his palm. If that arrow were mere marksmanship, it would have saved no one.
story.yuanshemen.win.hook: The camp gate saved Xiaopei, but not Lü Bu's own Xiapi; and Cao Cao, out of Xuchang, has already set out for Wancheng.
story.yuanshemen.loss.text: Before the arrow even leaves the string, Ji Ling and Liu Bei are both on their feet. You were busy guaranteeing the hit for Lü Bu — and forgot to ask whether the other two would stake an army order and a city's people on the same sentence.
story.yuanshemen.loss.clue: Lesson · Brokering peace isn't offending neither side; it's making both sides accept the same stake first. Don't overpromise before the arrow flies. On retry, false tells are reduced.
story.wancheng.objective: On the night Zhang Xiu's surrender turns to revolt, guard Dian Wei's twin halberds first — then keep one last line of retreat open for Cao Cao.
story.wancheng.coldOpen.0.text: Wancheng's flag of surrender has barely come down, and Cao's camp is already singing deep into the night. Dian Wei sits outside the tent, halberds in his arms. Only you notice an extra pair of feet in the wall's shadow.
story.wancheng.coldOpen.1.text: I still remember that warmed cup of wine at Sishui. A pity — tonight men's hearts cooled faster than wine, and I never tasted it.
story.wancheng.coldOpen.2.text: Sleep well, my lord. Dian Wei knows nothing of cards — only this door: while I stand, my halberds stand, and so does the door.
story.wancheng.coldOpen.3.text: Must a surrendered general bow his head to earn his wine? Lord Cao — come count with me who owes whom, tonight.
story.wancheng.intros.zhangxiu.0.bio: A surrender flag can be raised a second time. A silent humiliation, once suffered, cannot be taken back.
story.wancheng.intros.zhangxiu.0.quote: This time, ask nothing of the twin halberds. Ask first whether you'll hear me to the end.
story.wancheng.intros.zhangxiu.1.bio: The Spear King of the Northlands has surrendered once already; when he strikes again, there will be no second hesitation.
story.wancheng.intros.zhangxiu.1.quote: Surrender by day, spear-song by night. Sit down, Lord Cao.
story.wancheng.map.0.title: Wancheng · The Twin Halberds Hold
story.wancheng.map.0.lines.0.text: Hu Che'er has toasted me three bowls tonight, but his eyes keep resting on the halberds. If the weapons go, what do I guard my lord's retreat with?
story.wancheng.map.0.lines.1.text: Zhang Xiu has surrendered — so why does he sit like a man on needles? Did I mistake 'submission' for 'nothing left to say'?
story.wancheng.map.0.choices.0.text: Stand with Dian Wei over the halberds and the horse road behind camp
story.wancheng.map.0.choices.0.detail: Reading improves this chapter; halberds and retreat guarded together
story.wancheng.map.0.choices.1.text: Let the surrendered troops return to their old camps, weapons in hand
story.wancheng.map.0.choices.1.detail: Zhang Xiu opens with -1 morale; remember the surrendered soldiers' hearts
story.wancheng.battle.0.text: By day you accepted my surrender; by night you treated me as a man with nothing left to say. This spear of Zhang Xiu's is only now being delivered.
story.wancheng.battle.1.text: Did I misread Zhang Xiu, or myself? Dian Wei — let no one into the tent.
story.wancheng.battle.2.text: My lord, go! The halberds are still here. No man alive makes Dian Wei guard a door empty-handed tonight.
story.wancheng.battle.3.text: My lord, go! Ask not how much longer Dian Wei can stand — ask only whether the horses are ready.
story.wancheng.win.text: The twin halberds stay in Dian Wei's hands; Zhang Xiu's fire never seals the camp gate. Cao Cao is a long way down the road before he looks back, and for the first time he does not ask how many men he lost — only, 'Is Dian Wei still at his post?' Behind him, the big man lifts a halberd in answer.
story.wancheng.win.hook: Wancheng's gate held, but Cao Cao has no time to grow wiser. He is already at the walls of Xiapi — and this time the one besieged is Lü Bu.
story.wancheng.loss.text: Only when the halberds are stolen do you understand: what Zhang Xiu waited for was not Cao Cao asleep, but Cao Cao mistaking another man's humiliation for safety. Fire still burns at the gate, and Dian Wei does not fall back again.
story.wancheng.loss.clue: Lesson · Zhang Xiu's resolve was written the moment he stopped looking at Cao Cao. Don't fixate on the spear point; guard the gate and the halberds first. On retry, false tells are reduced.
story.baimenlou.objective: Find the true dead end between Lü Bu and Chen Gong, and decide whether Xiapi gets a tomorrow.
story.baimenlou.coldOpen.0.text: Outside the walls, Cao's army. Inside, soldiers three days without water. And the Warm Lord still says: were he only allowed to ride out, he could not lose.
story.baimenlou.coldOpen.1.text: At Hulao you won the cards. Dare you wager your life one more time?
story.baimenlou.coldOpen.2.text: You've come. I've read that page of Hulao — but this time, what needs saving is not his winning name.
story.baimenlou.coldOpen.3.text: The rope at White Gate Tower hangs just outside the page. Every hand you win brings it into focus.
story.baimenlou.intros.lvbu.0.bio: Beaten once at Hulao, Lü Bu is all the less willing to admit he is already trapped.
story.baimenlou.intros.lvbu.0.quote: You can make me lose. Can you make me live?
story.baimenlou.intros.lvbu.1.bio: The Si River drowns the city, and the finest under heaven is still waiting for a direction worth charging.
story.baimenlou.intros.lvbu.1.quote: Stand aside. I'll cut one more road out.
story.baimenlou.intros.chengong.0.bio: He has not come to win for Lü Bu. He has come to beg one road out for Xiapi.
story.baimenlou.intros.chengong.0.quote: If all you can do is win hands, you cannot save him.
story.baimenlou.map.0.title: The Si River · The Last Counsel
story.baimenlou.map.0.lines.0.text: I urged him out of the city. He asked me whether he would still be Lü Bu once he left it. There — that is his true cage.
story.baimenlou.map.0.lines.1.text: Xuande is on the tower too. If you save Fengxian today — who reins him in tomorrow?
story.baimenlou.map.0.choices.0.text: Let Chen Gong finish describing that one road out
story.baimenlou.map.0.choices.0.detail: Reading improves; remember Chen Gong's counsel
story.baimenlou.map.0.choices.1.text: Make Lü Bu promise, in his own words, not to charge blindly again
story.baimenlou.battle.0.text: Watch for when his stack falls below three tenths. A cornered beast shoves in its last scrap of reason too.
story.baimenlou.battle.1.text: Chen Gong! If I obey you this once — will the world laugh at me?
story.baimenlou.battle.2.text: It will. But only the living get to be laughed at.
story.baimenlou.win.text: In the end Lü Bu does not charge the gate. He lifts off his golden headdress and, for the first time, asks Chen Gong: 'Where do we retreat?' For one night, the weeping in Xiapi stops.
story.baimenlou.win.hook: The green plums of Xuchang are ripening. Cao Cao has already heard: the finest under heaven did not die — and you were at that table.
story.baimenlou.loss.text: Only as the rope draws tight do you realize: all along you answered 'how to beat Lü Bu,' and never once answered 'how Lü Bu might agree to live.'
story.baimenlou.loss.clue: Lesson · Chen Gong has read the rhythm of a cornered beast. On retry, his false tells are reduced.
story.xianshan.objective: In the bamboo shadows of Xian Mountain, read that arrow for Sun Jian — keep the fire of Jiangdong from dying at the first stroke.
story.xianshan.coldOpen.0.text: Luoyang's embers are still warm; the Imperial Seal burns against Sun Jian's chest. On the walls of Xiangyang, Liu Biao's second arrow is already nocked.
story.xianshan.coldOpen.1.text: I fought my way from Changsha to Luoyang and never lost a battle. And Liu Jingsheng thinks one city and a few arrows will keep a Jiangdong tiger?
story.xianshan.coldOpen.2.text: My lord, the bamboo on Xian Mountain is thick — the pursuit should not go in full strength. Better to send scouts ahead; this old minister will hold the rear.
story.xianshan.coldOpen.3.text: Demou, you are over-cautious. That 'Lü Gong' is fleeing so fast his helmet sits crooked. If we don't press now, Liu Biao really will find his reinforcements!
story.xianshan.coldOpen.4.text: In the apocrypha, the tiger often dies on the very day it trusts its own claws most.
story.xianshan.intros.huangzu.0.bio: He remembers how fast Sun Jian's blade is; this time he has buried his ambush deeper.
story.xianshan.intros.huangzu.0.quote: Another Sun-family tiger. Xian Mountain has arrows to spare.
story.xianshan.intros.huangzu.1.bio: He cannot beat Sun Jian — but he knows the man's nature. A tiger never goes around.
story.xianshan.intros.huangzu.1.quote: Jiangxia's arrows have waited two years for this day.
story.xianshan.intros.caimao.0.bio: The fleet's escape route is set; one task remains — don't let the Cai family sink with the ship.
story.xianshan.intros.caimao.0.quote: I hold the water this time. The mountain is yours, General Huang.
story.xianshan.intros.caimao.1.bio: He has traded his sister's pillow-talk and his brother-in-law's command seals alike for chips.
story.xianshan.intros.caimao.1.quote: Jingzhou's waters raise no tigers. General, don't waste your arrows.
story.xianshan.map.0.title: Deng Sai · Shadows in the Bamboo
story.xianshan.map.0.lines.0.text: Movement in the bamboo — too many to count. Let me take the volunteers in first, my lord; you hold back.
story.xianshan.map.0.lines.1.text: I hear you, Yigong. But if I hold back, every man behind me will move half a beat slower on my behalf.
story.xianshan.map.0.lines.2.text: A tiger's courage is at the front of the line. A tiger's way out is usually in that one glance over the shoulder.
story.xianshan.map.0.choices.0.text: Send Han Dang to scout the bamboo first; advance slowly
story.xianshan.map.0.choices.0.detail: Reading improves this chapter; note the doubt in the bamboo shadows
story.xianshan.map.0.choices.1.text: Ride with the tiger and punch straight through the bamboo
story.xianshan.map.0.choices.1.detail: War chest +100; enemy opens with -1 morale
story.xianshan.battle.0.text: Sun Jian! You have chased us for two days — and the arrows have chased you for two!
story.xianshan.battle.1.text: Don't answer every drumbeat. Bamboo rattles; not everything that rattles is a man.
story.xianshan.battle.2.text: Arrow storm incoming. Watch the banner, not the man — the banner falls toward where the ambush truly is.
story.xianshan.battle.3.text: My lord, change horses! Gongfu's back can still take one more volley!
story.xianshan.win.text: Arrow after arrow finds only bamboo. Pinned under his horse, Huang Zu is still shouting 'impossible.' Sun Jian does not kill him — he snaps two of his arrows instead: 'Go tell Liu Jingsheng I'll be knocking on Xiangyang's gate myself next year.' That is how the fire of Jiangdong crossed Xian Mountain.
story.xianshan.win.hook: The tiger lives, and Jiangdong's story finds its next name — the white horses of Jieqiao are already galloping toward Youzhou.
story.xianshan.loss.text: The instant the arrows find you among the bamboo, you see how orderly that 'rout' really was. The tiger died in the pursuit — and Jiangdong must wait for a boy to catch the falling name.
story.xianshan.loss.clue: Lesson · Huang Zu's ambush baits you into going all-in on 'chaos.' When the bamboo rattles, look at the banners first. On retry, his false tells are reduced.
story.jieqiao.objective: At Jieqiao, shield the White Horse Volunteers from the Vanguard Corps' crossbows — and win Zhao Yun his first duel the world actually sees.
story.jieqiao.coldOpen.0.text: The white-horse volunteers of Youzhou are called the finest cavalry under heaven — until, across the river at Jieqiao, eight hundred men of the Vanguard Corps quietly raise their crossbows.
story.jieqiao.coldOpen.1.text: One charge, and Hebei goes quiet for ten years. In Youzhou, Bogui has seen the strongest wolves — never wolves that know how to wait.
story.jieqiao.coldOpen.2.text: I came from Changshan to serve an army that holds its ground — not one that dies for nothing. General, their line is uneven. Something waits behind it.
story.jieqiao.coldOpen.3.text: Cavalry? Cross the river, and you're rows of targets that still breathe.
story.jieqiao.coldOpen.4.text: His Lordship says: today Hebei's spears teach Youzhou how they are used.
story.jieqiao.intros.quyi.0.bio: He remembers how your white horses swung wide of his crossbows last time; this time he keeps the shields lower still.
story.jieqiao.intros.quyi.0.quote: Swinging wide again? My crossbows have more than one row.
story.jieqiao.intros.quyi.1.bio: His eight hundred men have all seen blood, and not one of them fears a horse.
story.jieqiao.intros.quyi.1.quote: Come across the river. My crossbows have waited a long time.
story.jieqiao.intros.wenchou.0.bio: Yan Liang's name is his scar and his fire — he heard that battle was lost in a fog no one could explain.
story.jieqiao.intros.wenchou.0.quote: Of Hebei's twin walls, one is down. Today I make up the difference.
story.jieqiao.intros.wenchou.1.bio: He still disputes the last battle — but his spear has put away three parts of its contempt.
story.jieqiao.intros.wenchou.1.quote: This time I wait for you to cross first.
story.jieqiao.intros.wenchou.2.bio: He and Yan Liang are called the twin walls of Hebei; the one thing he has over Yan Liang is patience.
story.jieqiao.intros.wenchou.2.quote: I'm in no hurry. My spear is longer than yours. I can wait.
story.jieqiao.map.0.title: Jieqiao · The Half-Crossing
story.jieqiao.map.0.lines.0.text: The bridge is narrow, the horses packed tight. If the Vanguard looses at our half-crossing, no number of white horses can form a line.
story.jieqiao.map.0.lines.1.text: Zilong is too careful. Once, with a few dozen riders, I cut clean through the Xianbei wolf packs.
story.jieqiao.map.0.lines.2.text: A breakthrough lives on surprise. The men across the river are waiting for exactly one thing — your charge.
story.jieqiao.map.0.choices.0.text: Dismount the vanguard, lock shields, lead the horses across
story.jieqiao.map.0.choices.0.detail: Reading improves this chapter; remember the peril of the half-crossing
story.jieqiao.map.0.choices.1.text: White horses at full gallop, straight into the Vanguard
story.jieqiao.map.0.choices.1.detail: War chest +100; Vanguard opens with -1 morale
story.jieqiao.battle.0.text: Shields — up! Crossbows — raise! Show the men of Youzhou what the Vanguard Corps is!
story.jieqiao.battle.1.text: Every time his shield drops, a crossbow rewinds. Count his rhythm, not his arrows.
story.jieqiao.battle.2.text: The white horses are broken! Hebei's spears — collect the debt!
story.jieqiao.battle.3.text: Half the volunteers are down... Zilong, you were right. Bogui rushed it.
story.jieqiao.win.text: You count the crossbow line down to its last beat; the white horses wheel in three troops, and the shield wall finally cracks at one corner. When Wen Chiu spears in to save it, Zhao Yun's point holds him off: 'A steady spear, General — a pity it serves a proud man.' Yuan Shao's center falls back across the river. On both banks of Jieqiao, the name Zhao Zilong of Changshan is known from this day.
story.jieqiao.win.hook: Gongsun Zan wins the field and loses to his own high walls. Meanwhile, at Fengyi Pavilion in Mei, another rift between father and son is waiting to bloom.
story.jieqiao.loss.text: At the half-crossing the crossbows speak as one, and the white horses fall in rows into the river. Zhao Yun holds the rear and pulls Gongsun Zan clear, then looks back at you once, and says nothing.
story.jieqiao.loss.clue: Lesson · Qu Yi's crossbows win by making you charge. On retry his false tells are reduced; don't push the volunteers in at the half-crossing.
story.shenting.objective: On Shenting Ridge, let the two weapons fight to the very end of the match — leave Sun Ce and Taishi Ci both their dignity.
story.shenting.coldOpen.0.text: Outside Qu'a, scouts report: Sun Ce has taken twelve riders to probe Liu Yao's camp. Taishi Ci takes up his spear and mounts — followed by a single foot soldier who knows how to beat a drum.
story.shenting.coldOpen.1.text: They all call me the Little Conqueror. Today there's no line and no drum on this ridge — a fine time to see what's left under the title.
story.shenting.coldOpen.2.text: Taishi Ci of Donglai — a man who can't always feed himself, yet never loses with the spear. A fight, then. Let's see who blinks!
story.shenting.coldOpen.3.text: Bofu, the wind on Shenting Ridge is wrong. Midway through this fight, a third party will come.
story.shenting.intros.taishici.0.bio: That business with the halberd and the armor taught him your name — and your fairness.
story.shenting.intros.taishici.0.quote: You again. This time, lend me your eyes — let's see who deserves to win.
story.shenting.intros.taishici.1.bio: He has heard of the scroll-reader at Jieqiao who counted the drumbeats of a crossbow line; his spear carries three extra parts of respect.
story.shenting.intros.taishici.1.quote: A man who can count a crossbow line can surely count my spear.
story.shenting.intros.taishici.2.bio: He honors only two things in this life: his mother's teaching, and opponents worth beating.
story.shenting.intros.taishici.2.quote: The wind on the ridge is strong. Grip your weapon tight!
story.shenting.map.0.title: Shenting Ridge · A Duel Without Drums
story.shenting.map.0.lines.0.text: No orders here, no formation maps. Scheme for either man, and this fight is no longer clean.
story.shenting.map.0.lines.1.text: Good! Then clear the field. Gongjin, back off thirty paces — today is a duel. Anyone who interferes answers to me!
story.shenting.map.0.lines.2.text: Then I'll stand to one side and watch. Watch who shows his true skill first — and who shows his true self first.
story.shenting.map.0.choices.0.text: Keep your hands folded; memorize both men's spear lines
story.shenting.map.0.choices.0.detail: Reading improves this chapter; remember the spear lines of Shenting
story.shenting.map.0.choices.1.text: Set wine on the ridge; wager on who tires first
story.shenting.map.0.choices.1.detail: War chest +120; both men fight all the harder
story.shenting.battle.0.text: Little Conqueror — take my spear! Don't let anyone look down on the likes of us!
story.shenting.battle.1.text: Fine halberd work! Faster with the spear — the hand of a Sun does not shake yet!
story.shenting.battle.2.text: I've got your helmet — the armor's next. Still want more? I'll go all the way!
story.shenting.battle.3.text: When two tigers fight, one is bound to bleed — and the one who bleeds must hold a city tomorrow.
story.shenting.win.text: The halberd snaps, the armor splits, and the two of them lie on the ridge hugging their weapons, gasping — then burst out laughing at the same instant. Taishi Ci sits up: 'Sun Lang, tomorrow on the field I won't yield an inch.' Sun Ce tosses him the broken halberd: 'Keep it. Mend it, and come again.' You pour the ridge-top wine into two bowls — one for the winner, one for the man who didn't lose.
story.shenting.win.hook: The laughter on Shenting has not faded, and the map of Jiangdong waits to be drawn. In Xiaopei, a painted halberd is about to make peace between two houses.
story.shenting.loss.text: Your interference sours the duel, and both weapons point at you at once. Taishi Ci draws his spear back, disappointed: 'So even a scroll-reader can flip the table.'
story.shenting.loss.clue: Lesson · This page asks not for a quick win, but for both men to fight the full match. On retry, watch who tires first before you bet.
story.zhujiu.objective: Hide your own answer — and hear clearly the one sentence Cao Cao never says.
story.zhujiu.coldOpen.0.text: On White Gate Tower you chose a road for him to live by. Over today's cup, I want to know what you chose for yourself.
story.zhujiu.coldOpen.1.text: If he brings up Fengxian, don't rush to answer. First listen to how many heroes he counts before he reaches the world.
story.zhujiu.coldOpen.2.text: Since White Gate Tower, Xuande has grown more careful. Careful men make the best drinking companions.
story.zhujiu.coldOpen.3.text: Green plums over a small cup; a clap of thunder in the distance. Suddenly you understand: not one question at this table is about the world.
story.zhujiu.intros.caocao.0.bio: He remembers every choice made at White Gate Tower — above all, who you let live.
story.zhujiu.intros.caocao.0.quote: Fengxian lives; Xuande sits at this table. The heroes of today number more than two, I fear.
story.zhujiu.intros.caocao.1.bio: Over wine and green plums, he treats every man's ambition as a hole card waiting to be flipped.
story.zhujiu.intros.caocao.1.quote: Don't fear the thunder. Fear my next sentence.
story.zhujiu.map.0.title: The Plum Pavilion · Answered Before Asked
story.zhujiu.map.0.lines.0.text: When he names you a hero, mere modesty tells him you understood. You must do better than that.
story.zhujiu.map.0.lines.1.text: Then I should play the fool?
story.zhujiu.map.0.lines.2.text: No. Let him believe cards are the only thing you understand.
story.zhujiu.map.0.choices.0.text: Hide your face behind the thunder
story.zhujiu.map.0.choices.1.text: Ask him, instead, what he feared most at White Gate Tower
story.zhujiu.battle.0.text: Cards are like men. Look first; don't be quick to claim them.
story.zhujiu.battle.1.text: The heroes of the age — tell me, whom do you think I will name first?
story.zhujiu.battle.2.text: The thunder is coming. You should drop your chopsticks now.
story.zhujiu.win.text: The chopsticks fall; the thunder stops. Cao Cao smiles and pours your wine himself, and does not ask a second time. Liu Bei knows that for one instant, all three of you saw each other's hole cards.
story.zhujiu.win.hook: Guan Yu is about to seal the seal and hang up the gold. In the game at Xuchang, Cao Cao has learned how well you can hide your edge.
story.zhujiu.loss.text: You answered 'who are the heroes' — and missed his real question: 'will you be my enemy?' The wine held no poison; the words closed in around you all the same.
story.zhujiu.loss.clue: Lesson · Cao Cao starts reading your bets from the second hand on. On retry, his false tells are reduced.
story.qianli.objective: Escort the carriage train through five passes; learn how Kong Xiu, Han Fu, Bian Xi, Wang Zhi, and Qin Qi each mean to bar the way — and save your last strength for the reunion at Gucheng.
story.qianli.coldOpen.0.text: The gates of Xuchang behind him: the seal hangs high, the gold untouched. Guan Yu carries only the carriages and a blade that will owe no more favors.
story.qianli.coldOpen.1.text: That day over wine, Xuande hid his edge behind the thunder. Today Yunchang rides to find him. Should I let him go — or keep him for one more round of drinks?
story.qianli.coldOpen.2.text: I keep the Chancellor's kindness in my heart, but my oath to my brother waits on the road ahead.
story.qianli.coldOpen.3.text: Yunchang — these words in place of my face. Grieve for me no more than you would blame me. Come if you can. Someone in Gucheng is waiting.
story.qianli.intros.kongxiu.0.bio: The lock at Dongling Pass recognizes only documents; he guards his duty more narrowly than his own life.
story.qianli.intros.kongxiu.0.quote: Without the Chancellor's pass, not even Guan Yunchang goes through.
story.qianli.intros.hanfu.0.bio: He keeps his respect hidden behind a bowstring, wanting one last piece of the old goodwill before he lets the arrow fly.
story.qianli.intros.hanfu.0.quote: General Guan, Han Fu honors you — but he cannot abandon his gate. After this arrow, bear me no grudge.
story.qianli.intros.bianxi.0.bio: The incense of Zhenguo Temple cannot smother the smell of blood; his road to safety leads only to ambush.
story.qianli.intros.bianxi.0.quote: Leave the blade before the Buddha, drink the wine, and the General may sleep in peace.
story.qianli.intros.wangzhi.0.bio: The guesthouse at Xingyang is too neat; every door has already decided when it will be locked.
story.qianli.intros.wangzhi.0.quote: The night is long and the road far. Why not stay — until the fire rises... until dawn, I mean?
story.qianli.intros.qinqi.0.bio: The last military order stands at the Yellow River ferry; he bars old acquaintances and rough water alike from the shore.
story.qianli.intros.qinqi.0.quote: Four passes behind you — so what? The Yellow River knows one flag only: Qin Qi's.
story.qianli.map.0.title: Luoyang · Two Passes, One Bright, One Dark
story.qianli.map.0.lines.0.text: Kong Xiu demands papers, Han Fu hides a cold arrow, and Bian Xi sets his wine before the Buddha. Different passes, different reasons to bar the road.
story.qianli.map.0.lines.1.text: No urging from the carriages. Guan Yu looks back down the road, then shifts his blade from right hand to left — only to put the drivers at ease.
story.qianli.map.0.choices.0.text: Trade rations for the common folk's telling of the five passes
story.qianli.map.0.choices.0.detail: Reading improves this chapter; remember the hearts along the road
story.qianli.map.0.choices.1.text: Take the rear guard yourself; send the carriages ahead
story.qianli.map.0.choices.1.detail: Gate commanders open with -1 morale; remember the promise of the rear guard
story.qianli.battle.0.text: Dongling Pass honors the Chancellor's seal, not your old name. No papers — then the Green Dragon blade stays too.
story.qianli.battle.1.text: General Guan, Han Fu honors your name, but duty holds the gate. Once this arrow flies — forgive me.
story.qianli.battle.2.text: The wine at Zhenguo Temple is warmed. Leave the blade before the Buddha, and Bian Xi will show you a road to safety.
story.qianli.battle.3.text: The Xingyang guesthouse is clean, and the night is long. Why not rest, General — while I shut every door in the place for you?
story.qianli.battle.4.text: Here is the Yellow River. The goodwill of four passes is spent; Qin Qi answers only to General Xiahou's order.
story.qianli.battle.5.text: Five passes, five locks — but not every heart is a lock. When killing can be walked around, don't make it a sixth grave.
story.qianli.battle.6.text: Second Brother, hear the drums? No more guarding passes for anyone — come back and strike this one with me!
story.qianli.win.text: When Qin Qi falls, the roar of the Yellow River drowns the blade. Guan Yu does not count the fifth head; he turns and steadies the carriages. At the gate of Gucheng, Zhang Fei drops his drumsticks and seizes the horse in a hug. When Liu Bei arrives, Guan Yu says only, 'I'm late.' Three pairs of eyes give the same answer: late is fine. You came back.
story.qianli.win.hook: The drums of Gucheng have not gone quiet; Yuan and Cao are deadlocked in the north. Next comes no lone ride through five passes, but two armies fighting for one breath of pride.
story.qianli.loss.text: You won the blade-light at some pass or other — and left the carriages, the chips, and the promised day behind you. The hardest part of the thousand li was never cutting a straight road through. It was arriving at Gucheng still entitled to say, 'Everyone is safe.'
story.qianli.loss.clue: Lesson · Kong Xiu spends your permits, Han Fu fires cold arrows, Bian Xi lays a feast, Wang Zhi reaches for fire, Qin Qi holds the ferry. Five passes share one life; don't bet the whole road fund on a single gate. On retry, war chest +150.
story.guandu.objective: Turn Yuan Shao's deep war chest into hesitation, and find the true soft spot at Wuchao before the blinds swallow Cao's army whole.
story.guandu.coldOpen.0.text: At Guandu, the grain ledger runs thinner than the battle reports. Every day Cao Cao crosses off, Yuan Shao's tent gains another adviser who claims to have a plan.
story.guandu.coldOpen.1.text: Mengde, we've known each other since we were boys. I know your temper. Your granaries, I know even better.
story.guandu.coldOpen.2.text: So Yunchang went to Xuande after all. I kept the Red Hare and lost the man. Benchu — you never even saw the man to lose.
story.guandu.coldOpen.3.text: My lord, of the ten victories and ten defeats, I will vouch only for the first nine. The tenth you must go out and win yourself.
story.guandu.coldOpen.4.text: If my lord wins, Feng must die. If he loses, Feng dies as well. In a Jizhou cell, Yuanhao has already written your verdict for you.
story.guandu.coldOpen.5.text: When Xu You comes, seat him. I will greet him with one shoe missing — but the whole army must not see that I have three days of grain left.
story.guandu.intros.yuanshao.0.bio: He heard the plum pavilion ranked only Liu and Cao — so he means to turn an old friends' table into a public defense of the world.
story.guandu.intros.yuanshao.0.quote: Mengde — count the heroes again today. Is Yuan Benchu still on the list?
story.guandu.intros.yuanshao.1.bio: He returns with a thousand companies and a belly full of stratagems, still missing the one thing: a man willing to sign his name to a decision.
story.guandu.intros.yuanshao.1.quote: Last time the council could not decide. This time — whose voice will you follow?
story.guandu.intros.yuanshao.2.bio: Four generations of high office gave him too many advisers, and a seat from which he never has to be the first to admit error.
story.guandu.intros.yuanshao.2.quote: Hebei's troops are seasoned, her granaries full. What will you stretch, Mengde?
story.guandu.map.0.title: Guandu · True Ledger, False Ledger
story.guandu.map.0.lines.0.text: Xu You asks how much grain I have left. Tell him the truth, and he may hand me Wuchao. Lie, and he walks tonight.
story.guandu.map.0.lines.1.text: Outside, Yuan Shao's drums press closer with every beat. Cao Cao slides the true ledger toward you: what burns tonight is not grain — it is his habit of letting others decide for him.
story.guandu.map.0.choices.0.text: Trade the true grain count for one true sentence from Xu You
story.guandu.map.0.choices.0.detail: Reading improves this chapter; remember the barefoot welcome
story.guandu.map.0.choices.1.text: Feint with split columns; leave Wuchao as the only real move
story.guandu.map.0.choices.1.detail: Yuan Shao opens with -200 war chest; remember the Wuchao raid
story.guandu.battle.0.text: Every hand you play counts the days you have left to live. I need only wait. Hebei has never feared one more war council.
story.guandu.battle.1.text: Benchu, it isn't that you don't know whom to heed. It's that you fear having no one left to blame if you heed them wrongly.
story.guandu.battle.2.text: Wuchao has not burned, and every general of Hebei waits for someone else to change his tune first. A thousand stratagems, and suddenly not one will sign its name.
story.guandu.battle.3.text: Tian Feng, Ju Shou, Xu You — which of them failed me? You tell me first, Mengde!
story.guandu.win.text: No fire at Wuchao — and yet, one by one, the lamps go out in Yuan Shao's tent. Cao Cao does not gloat at his old friend; he simply closes the ledger padded with false grain: 'Benchu, you lost because every man in that tent was waiting for someone else to concede first.'
story.guandu.win.hook: The north will soon be settled, but Liu Bei waits in Xinye for a snowfall. Cao Cao has advisers enough to fill a tent — and still has not found the one man willing to open a door.
story.guandu.loss.text: The fire at Wuchao never catches. Yuan Shao still sits behind his heaps of dispatches — each one sound, each one someone else's responsibility. And your grain truly runs out, day by day.
story.guandu.loss.clue: Lesson · Yuan Shao's mountain of chips is not his weakness; his dread of owning a decision is. Force him to choose before the blinds climb. On retry, raid Wuchao first: enemy war chest -200.
story.sangu.objective: Give each of the three knocks its own meaning: return after the first two visits whatever the score — and on the third, finally hear what the Sleeping Dragon truly wants to ask about the world.
story.sangu.coldOpen.0.text: The road from Xinye to Longzhong — Liu Bei has walked it twice. Zhang Fei calls the third trip, through wind and snow, a waste of shoe leather. Guan Yu merely brushes off his brother's visiting card one more time.
story.sangu.coldOpen.1.text: Second Brother rode a thousand li and back, and now I get it — distance ain't the problem. But what kind of man makes us knock three times?
story.sangu.coldOpen.2.text: If he will come out of seclusion for the people, what is a few more walks to Bei?
story.sangu.coldOpen.3.text: Battles can be hurried; a door cannot. Yide, put the fire-striker away.
story.sangu.intros.zhuge.0.bio: Since Bowang he watches not only whether you have patience, but whether you can let another man take the credit.
story.sangu.intros.zhuge.0.quote: Since the thatched hall, you have learned to yield. Today — will you still wait?
story.sangu.intros.zhuge.1.bio: He remembers who won and lost on both earlier visits; he simply refuses to use either as a key to the door.
story.sangu.intros.zhuge.1.quote: I saw the wins and losses. Today — why have you come again?
story.sangu.intros.zhuge.2.bio: He listened to two snowstorms from behind the door; only on the third did he lay the world out on the table.
story.sangu.intros.zhuge.2.quote: Come in, General. Never mind the world for now — can you sit still long enough?
story.sangu.map.0.title: Longzhong · A Door That Cannot Be Hurried
story.sangu.map.0.lines.0.text: If he is out again today, I will leave my card. Seeking worthies does not mean the whole world must rise at Liu Bei's hour.
story.sangu.map.0.lines.1.text: Then I'll wait out here! And if waiting frays my temper, I'll count snowflakes — not his faults.
story.sangu.map.0.lines.2.text: If you can wait like that, Brother, this trip was already worth the cold.
story.sangu.map.0.choices.0.text: Order the whole escort out of armor; wait quietly at the gate
story.sangu.map.0.choices.0.detail: Sleeping Dragon opens with -1 morale; remember the courtesy of disarmed men
story.sangu.map.0.choices.1.text: Ask not about the world — ask first whether the Master sleeps well
story.sangu.map.0.choices.1.detail: Reading improves this chapter; remember the question that did not press
story.sangu.battle.0.text: First visit: the Master is away. You may win this hand, but you cannot win his consent to meet.
story.sangu.battle.1.text: Lost is lost, Brother. We come back tomorrow. Better than standing here guarding another man's door!
story.sangu.battle.2.text: Second visit: snow to the eaves of the thatched hall. You have come again — this time, do you seek a win, or do you seek a man?
story.sangu.battle.3.text: Yunchang, Yide — the snow is heavier; stand closer. The Master may decline to see us, but we must not lose the reason we came.
story.sangu.battle.4.text: The boy at the door and the cold welcomes of the first two visits — Liang borrowed both to ask you this: does victory make you swagger, and does defeat still bring you back? You came three times. The door should open.
story.sangu.battle.5.text: No talk of cards yet, General. Do you want Jing and Yi — or a world where the people no longer have to run?
story.sangu.battle.6.text: If the Master will not come down from the mountain, Bei will keep coming. If he walks with us, then this road belongs to more than Bei alone.
story.sangu.win.text: Zhuge Liang writes Jing and Yi side by side under the same lamp, but writes nothing of host and guest. Liu Bei rises and bows low; Guan Yu sheathes his blade; Zhang Fei drags over a fourth stool for you. At last — a hand where nobody has to be made to concede.
story.sangu.win.hook: The plan of Longzhong is set — and Cao Cao's vanguard has reached Xinye. The Sleeping Dragon's first fire must first win over the two men who believe in it least.
story.sangu.loss.text: On the third visit you finally see the map of Longzhong — and go right back to re-fighting the last two hands. Zhuge Liang folds his fan and says nothing. Patience is not walking a road twice more; it is hearing another man finish, even after you have seen the answer.
story.sangu.loss.clue: Lesson · Lose the first two visits and still return; don't stretch to win every hand. Save your strength for the third knock. On retry, war chest +150.
story.bowang.objective: Make Guan Yu and Zhang Fei believe in the war council's plan — and make Xiahou Dun believe every step of the pursuit was his own idea.
story.bowang.coldOpen.0.text: The grass on Bowang Slope has dried just right. Zhuge Liang weights the fire-striker under the map, and hands each man a road he must walk to the end while losing.
story.bowang.coldOpen.1.text: Three visits, and what won me over was my brother's courtesy. But if all you know is telling me to fall back — that I won't swallow!
story.bowang.coldOpen.2.text: Yide, fall back until you can hear Yunchang's gong. Before the fire, let's not turn a feint into a real rout.
story.bowang.coldOpen.3.text: Bei begged the Master down from the mountain not to fight your battles of pride, but to teach you not to bleed for nothing.
story.bowang.intros.xiahoudun.0.bio: He remembers the last ambush, yet still refuses to admit that a pursuit can be led by the nose.
story.bowang.intros.xiahoudun.0.quote: Same slope. I won't need you to show it to me twice.
story.bowang.intros.xiahoudun.1.bio: The single eye looks only forward; he reads every retreat as the enemy's cowardice.
story.bowang.intros.xiahoudun.1.quote: If Xinye holds nothing but fire, then let it burn Liu Bei first.
story.bowang.map.0.title: Bowang Slope · How Far to Fall Back
story.bowang.map.0.lines.0.text: The Military Advisor tells us each how many paces to give — and marks the very tree to stop behind. Seems playing 'defeated' is harder than playing victorious.
story.bowang.map.0.lines.1.text: My spear shows itself to Xiahou Dun first. If he bites on me, Yunchang and Yide get their true ambush.
story.bowang.map.0.lines.2.text: Fine! Then I'll lose convincingly. But whoever breaks and runs for real comes back to polish every spear in the army!
story.bowang.map.0.choices.0.text: Have Yunchang and Yide signal each other by gong
story.bowang.map.0.choices.0.detail: Xiahou Dun opens with -1 morale; remember the brothers' ambush
story.bowang.map.0.choices.1.text: Walk the bait road stage by stage with Zilong
story.bowang.map.0.choices.1.detail: Reading improves this chapter; remember each stage of the ambush
story.bowang.battle.0.text: Liu Xuande finds himself a strategist and suddenly all he does is retreat? Then I'll chase until there's no slope left for you to hide on.
story.bowang.battle.1.text: Xiahou Dun has bitten on my spear. Advisor — how far is the fire?
story.bowang.battle.2.text: No hurry. He chases because he is still winning. The fire is meant for this exact moment — the moment he is certain he is right.
story.bowang.battle.3.text: Now I get it! This retreat isn't handing him the road — it's handing him a narrower and narrower one!
story.bowang.win.text: Zhang Fei reins in his spear first; Guan Yu follows with a cupped-hand salute. Zhuge Liang does not accept the bow — he hands the scorched, bent banner to Zilong instead. Liu Bei smiles: from this day on, the brothers compete not over who charges first, but over who is willing to be the last to fall back.
story.bowang.win.hook: The fire of Bowang taught Cao's army the name Xinye. The next visit comes faster: Zilong will carry A'dou in his arms and cut his way out through a map of ambushes he knows by heart — in reverse.
story.bowang.loss.text: Xiahou Dun never rode into the fire, because your rout looked too much like a rout: the ambush rushed to rescue, the bait forgot to stop. Bowang Slope holds nothing but smoke — and not one soldier of Cao's stepped into the plan.
story.bowang.loss.clue: Lesson · Retreating is not fleeing. Every show of weakness must keep the next ambush — and the stake to buy back in. On retry, war chest +150; don't let the bait become a true rout.
story.changban.objective: With Cao Cao, Xiahou Dun, and Zhang He at one table in pursuit, bring Zhao Yun home with A'dou — and keep Zhang Fei standing on Dangyang Bridge.
story.changban.coldOpen.0.text: In the dust of Changban, civilians, baggage, and broken soldiers jam a single road. Zhao Yun walks against the flow; Zhang Fei reins in at the bridgehead and stops.
story.changban.coldOpen.1.text: My lord, my lady and young A'dou are still behind us. Yun will go and come back. If he does not — Yide, hold the bridge for me.
story.changban.coldOpen.2.text: I don't want your 'for me'! Come back and hold it yourself!
story.changban.coldOpen.3.text: Zhao Zilong of Changshan... Wen Pin has orders to bar the way, but no heart to hound you to death. This spear holds back three parts of itself.
story.changban.coldOpen.4.text: My order: Zhao Yun taken alive. As for the black-faced general on the bridge — I will see for myself what makes three armies stop.
story.changban.intros.wenpin.0.bio: After Red Cliffs he holds the old lands of Jingzhou, knowing the histories will record whether he pursued — and whether he didn't.
story.changban.intros.wenpin.0.quote: Chase or not chase at Changban — Pin still has not worked it out.
story.changban.intros.wenpin.1.bio: He remembers the spear half-withdrawn at Changban; when he strikes now, he leaves nothing in reserve.
story.changban.intros.wenpin.1.quote: This time you don't get through. My apologies to my old lord's family.
story.changban.intros.wenpin.2.bio: A Jingzhou veteran newly sworn to Cao's camp, every inch of his spear caught between present duty and old loyalty.
story.changban.intros.wenpin.2.quote: Pin patrols here under orders. The Changban road is closed.
story.changban.intros.caocao.0.bio: After the plum pavilion he still remembers that clap of thunder — now he means to force out the answer with a thousand companies.
story.changban.intros.caocao.0.quote: The thunder hid you once. Today I let a thousand armies turn your cards over.
story.changban.intros.caocao.1.bio: Fresh off the defeat at Bowang, he is warier still — and all the less willing to give Liu Bei another chance to regroup.
story.changban.intros.caocao.1.quote: Fire does not win twice. Pursue.
story.changban.intros.caocao.2.bio: He wants more than Xuande's defeat; he wants to see what kind of man an army in rout still turns around for.
story.changban.intros.caocao.2.quote: Zhao Yun alive. The rest — spare no one.
story.changban.intros.xiahoudun.0.bio: The fire of Bowang still burns in his one eye; he reads Zilong's wheeling charge as the same ambush again.
story.changban.intros.xiahoudun.0.quote: Zhuge is not on that bridge. Let's see who saves you now.
story.changban.intros.xiahoudun.1.bio: Meeting you again, he still knows only forward — but he has begun to suspect every retreat that opens too easily.
story.changban.intros.xiahoudun.1.quote: This time you fall back, I watch what's behind you first.
story.changban.intros.xiahoudun.2.bio: The one-eyed general carries Bowang's old fury; he is first to catch Zhao Yun — and the likeliest to overrun him.
story.changban.intros.xiahoudun.2.quote: Before Changban, first repay Bowang one arrow.
story.changban.intros.zhanghe.0.bio: He remembers how you found your path last time; this time every way back is inked onto his battle map.
story.changban.intros.zhanghe.0.quote: The road you slipped away by last time — this time I seal it myself.
story.changban.intros.zhanghe.1.bio: He does not race Xiahou Dun; he counts the paces left between Zhao Yun and Zhang Fei.
story.changban.intros.zhanghe.1.quote: One rescues, one holds the bridge. Separate them.
story.changban.map.0.title: Dangyang · Against the Tide of People
story.changban.map.0.lines.0.text: Zilong, Bei cannot order you to abandon the people to save my son. If you bring back A'dou and leave them under the blades, the battle is still mine to lose.
story.changban.map.0.lines.1.text: Yun understands. Seven passes in and out is not seven feats of daring — it is coming back every time still knowing someone is waiting.
story.changban.map.0.choices.0.text: Shield the people first; then follow the crying to A'dou
story.changban.map.0.choices.0.detail: Reading improves this chapter; remember the meaning of walking against the tide
story.changban.map.0.choices.1.text: Agree with Zilong: the bridge is found by Yide's banner color alone
story.changban.map.0.choices.1.detail: Pursuers open with -1 morale; remember the pact of the bridge
story.changban.map.1.title: Changban Slope · One Bridge, Three Orders
story.changban.map.1.lines.0.text: Too little dust behind the bridge and Cao Cao suspects a trick; too much, and the people have no road. Zilong isn't back yet, and I can't even break the bridge the way a man wants to break it!
story.changban.map.1.lines.1.text: Yide, leave a gap one horse wide. If three of them pursue together, make them fight over who crosses first.
story.changban.map.1.choices.0.text: Before breaking the bridge, leave one horse-wide track
story.changban.map.1.choices.0.detail: Reading improves this chapter; remember the thread of survival
story.changban.map.1.choices.1.text: Move three ragged banners; split three columns of pursuers
story.changban.map.1.choices.1.detail: Cao Cao opens with -150 war chest; remember the plan of divided pursuit
story.changban.battle.0.text: Yuanrang chases Zilong; Junyi cuts the home bridge. I want Xuande with no road left in any direction.
story.changban.battle.1.text: With A'dou in my arm, the spear cannot play only to win. Yide — does the bridge still stand?
story.changban.battle.2.text: Every time he wheels that horse, he is looking for the same man. Don't chase the spear — chase the bridge he keeps turning back toward.
story.changban.battle.3.text: That fire at Bowang — today I collect it out of your line of retreat!
story.changban.battle.4.text: Long as I'm still standing here, their hundred thousand have to come at me one at a time!
story.changban.win.text: Zhao Yun lays the child in Liu Bei's arms, and only then does Zhang Fei give up the bridgehead. Cao Cao does not punish Xiahou Dun or Zhang He; he just stares at the broken span: 'One dared to come back. One refused to leave. It wasn't the pursuit I lost.'
story.changban.win.hook: The boats of Hanjin are near — and Cao Cao has memorized that bridge. The next road runs to Jiangdong: Liu Bei needs the one sentence that will make Sun Quan commit troops.
story.changban.loss.text: Zhao Yun finds A'dou but no road back to the bridge; Zhang Fei's roar stops the pursuers, but not three military orders splitting apart at once. Lone courage wins a skirmish. It cannot save everyone.
story.changban.loss.clue: Lesson · Cao Cao wants a prisoner, Yuanrang wants revenge, Zhang He wants the bridge cut. Make them quarrel over one line of pursuit instead of pushing each down a road of his own. On retry, enemy morale -1.
story.baima.objective: Between Baima and Yanjin, win Guan Yu two great deeds — and win him, with them, one road home.
story.baima.coldOpen.0.text: Before the slopes of Baima, Yan Liang has cut down Song Xian and Wei Xu and beaten Xu Huang in twenty passes; Cao's generals go pale. Cao Cao turns his gaze to the one man who has kept his back to every battle report.
story.baima.coldOpen.1.text: Yunchang, I know your body is here and your heart is not. But Yan Liang's blade now hangs over the head of every general I have.
story.baima.coldOpen.2.text: I gave my word: two deeds and I go. After this battle, Chancellor, honor yours — I have already heard where Xuande is.
story.baima.coldOpen.3.text: Yan Liang's valor cannot be met head-on; Wen Chiu's temper can be played. Only one thing worries Fengxiao: after these two strokes of Yunchang's blade, no power on earth will hold him.
story.baima.coldOpen.4.text: Is Cao's camp out of men? Send up that red-faced horse-archer. Let's have a look.
story.baima.intros.yanliang.0.bio: He remembers a blade too fast to see; this time he digs his camp in deeper.
story.baima.intros.yanliang.0.quote: That blade... this time, I will see where it comes from.
story.baima.intros.yanliang.1.bio: The finest blade of Hebei — his winning streak has convinced him no faster blade exists under heaven.
story.baima.intros.yanliang.1.quote: Ten li of linked camps. Whoever comes, dies.
story.baima.intros.wenchou.0.bio: After Jieqiao he learned to wait; now Yanjin asks him to chase — and he hates nothing more than that contradiction.
story.baima.intros.wenchou.0.quote: You taught me to count the beats. This time, you count my hooves.

finale.title: The Writer Is Waiting
finale.seal.q: Seal it — keep the Three Kingdoms you rewrote
finale.seal.a: You lay the pen down on the last page. Some lived; others paid the bill for that happy ending. The Writer closes the cover: "This time, don't say you didn't know the price."
finale.restore.q: Restore it — let what happened, happen
finale.restore.a: You tear the apocrypha out page by page, and the record shows through again. They have not forgotten you. In the snow of Maicheng, in the autumn wind of Wuzhang, someone will suddenly remember: a reader once grieved on their behalf.
finale.unwritten.q: Tear it — the Three Kingdoms shall have no final draft
finale.unwritten.a: You tear out the last page, and the scraps become more blank pages. The Writer laughs: "Good. Then let every future heartbreak grow a new Three Kingdoms." The unfinished scroll opens here.
finale.memoryHuarong: He brings up Huarong first: "You spared Cao Cao — for honor, or because you couldn't watch him die?"
finale.memoryMaicheng: Then he turns to Maicheng: "On this page, you finally saw which hand Lü Meng was showing you."
finale.memoryDefault: He leafs through the pages you left behind: "Now tell me — which of these is the true Three Kingdoms?"
